GRANT AGREEMENT

Grant Number: LHAF-2027-042
Grantee: Brightpath Recovery Services, Inc.
Grantee Address: 2140 Weller Avenue, Calumet Harbor, Wisconsin 54241
Project: Rural Peer Recovery Coach Expansion
Grant Amount: Three Hundred Twenty Thousand and 00/100 Dollars ($320,000.00 USD)
Grant Period: January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2027
Date of Agreement: November 12, 2026

ARTICLE 1. AWARD AND PURPOSE

1.1 The Lakeshore Health Alliance Foundation (the "Foundation") awards to Brightpath Recovery Services, Inc. (the "Grantee") the sum of $320,000.00 to expand certified peer recovery coach services in Kewaunee, Door, and Oconto counties during the Grant Period.

1.2 The Grantee shall use the grant solely for the purposes described in Article 2 and the approved budget in Article 8. The grant may not be used for capital construction, for the purchase of real property, for endowment, or for costs incurred outside the Grant Period.

ARTICLE 2. PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS AND DELIVERABLES

2.1 The Grantee shall hire and deploy six (6) full-time certified peer recovery coaches, of whom at least four shall be based outside the city of Calumet Harbor.

2.2 Each peer recovery coach shall hold, or shall obtain within one hundred twenty (120) days of hire, certification as a Wisconsin Certified Peer Specialist. The Grantee shall maintain copies of current certifications in each personnel file.

2.3 The Grantee shall serve not fewer than 420 unduplicated individuals during the Grant Period and shall document a warm handoff to ongoing treatment for at least 55 percent of individuals served.

2.4 The Grantee shall establish written referral agreements with not fewer than five (5) emergency departments or crisis stabilization facilities and shall provide executed copies to the Foundation by April 30, 2027.

2.5 The Grantee shall maintain a coach-to-participant ratio not exceeding 1 to 35 at any time during the Grant Period.

ARTICLE 3. REPORTING

3.1 Interim Report. The Grantee shall submit an interim report covering January 1 through June 30, 2027, no later than July 31, 2027. The interim report shall address progress on each deliverable in Article 2, expenditures to date against the approved budget, staffing status, and any barriers to implementation.

Lakeshore Health Alliance Foundation — Grant LHAF-2027-042 — Page 2 of 5
[[PAGE]]
Lakeshore Health Alliance Foundation — Grant LHAF-2027-042 — Page 3 of 5

3.2 Quarterly Data Submission. The Grantee shall submit de-identified service data through the Foundation's secure portal within twenty (20) days after the close of each calendar quarter, using the data specification provided by the Foundation. The quarterly data submission is a data file only and does not satisfy the narrative reporting requirements of this Article.

3.3 Final Report. The Grantee shall submit a final report to the Foundation upon the conclusion of the Grant Period. The final report shall include:

     (a) a cumulative narrative describing all activities carried out under the grant;
     (b) final counts for each numeric deliverable stated in Article 2;
     (c) a final statement of expenditures compared against the approved budget in Article 8;
     (d) a description of outcomes for individuals served, including warm handoff rates;
     (e) an assessment of the sustainability of the peer recovery coach positions after the Grant Period; and
     (f) copies of any evaluation instruments or reports produced with grant funds.

3.4 The final report shall be submitted through the Foundation's grantee portal, signed by the Grantee's chief executive and chief financial officers. The Foundation will not accept a final report submitted by electronic mail.

3.5 The Foundation will review the final report and may request clarification or additional documentation. The Grantee shall respond to any such request within fifteen (15) days.

3.6 No further grant will be awarded to the Grantee until the final report has been received and accepted by the Foundation.

ARTICLE 4. FINANCIAL TERMS

4.1 The grant will be disbursed in two payments: $200,000 on or about January 20, 2027, and $120,000 on or about August 14, 2027, following acceptance of the interim report.

4.2 The Grantee shall maintain the grant funds in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles and shall track grant expenditures in a separate cost center.

4.3 The Grantee shall obtain the Foundation's written approval before shifting more than ten percent (10%) of the total grant amount between the budget categories listed in Article 8.

4.4 Unexpended grant funds shall be returned to the Foundation within sixty (60) days after the end of the Grant Period unless the Foundation approves a written request to extend the Grant Period.

ARTICLE 5. RECORDS, CONFIDENTIALITY, AND INSURANCE

5.1 The Grantee shall retain all records relating to this grant for six (6) years after the end of the Grant Period.

5.2 The Grantee shall comply with all applicable federal and state confidentiality requirements governing substance use disorder records, including 42 CFR Part 2, and shall not transmit any individually identifiable information to the Foundation.

5.3 The Grantee shall maintain professional liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 per claim covering the peer recovery coaches funded under this grant and shall provide a certificate of insurance to the Foundation before the first coach is deployed.

ARTICLE 6. ACKNOWLEDGMENT AND PUBLICITY

6.1 The Grantee shall acknowledge the Lakeshore Health Alliance Foundation in program materials, on its website, and in any public announcement of the program using the language "Supported by the Lakeshore Health Alliance Foundation."

6.2 The Grantee shall not use the Foundation's name in any fundraising appeal without prior written consent.

ARTICLE 7. GENERAL PROVISIONS

7.1 The Grantee shall notify the Foundation within fifteen (15) days of any change in its executive leadership, any loss or suspension of a license required to operate the program, or any event that materially impairs its ability to perform.

7.2 The Foundation may suspend payments or terminate this grant upon thirty (30) days written notice for material breach, and may require repayment of funds not expended in accordance with this Agreement.

7.3 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Wisconsin.

ARTICLE 8. APPROVED BUDGET

     Peer recovery coach salaries (6.0 FTE)                    $198,000
     Fringe benefits (26%)                                     $ 51,480
     Program supervision (0.25 FTE)                            $ 22,000
     Travel and mileage, rural counties                        $ 14,600
     Training and certification costs                          $  9,200
     Participant assistance fund                               $  8,720
     Administrative overhead (5%)                              $ 16,000
     TOTAL                                                     $320,000
